0022600006.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Philadelphia 76ers, who have no 2026-27 games on record yet. Cleveland is without Khalifa Diop (knee), Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back) and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness), all listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (back) and Tacko Fall (hip), all ruled out. The Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 115-101 win in Cleveland on March 9, 2026, their last meeting.
